key: 只提取框选区域内的文本。关闭后与普通 PaddleOCR 插件一致（整图识别）。
en_US: Only extract text inside selected regions. When disabled
column3: behaves like the normal PaddleOCR plugin (full-image OCR).

key: 裁剪识别：只把每个区域裁剪下来识别，速度快。整图过滤：整图识别一遍，再只保留区域内的文字块。
en_US: Crop mode: only the region is cropped and recognized (fast). Filter mode: OCR the whole image once
column3: then keep only text blocks inside the regions.

key: 保存框选区域的 JSON 文件（百分比坐标）。删除该文件，或勾选「重新框选区域」后，下次识别会重新弹出框选窗口。
en_US: JSON file that stores the selected regions (percentage coordinates). Delete this file or enable "Reselect regions" to pop up the selection window again.

key: 勾选后，本次识别只弹出一次框选窗口，重新框选并覆盖已保存的区域（不会逐张弹窗）。引擎参数不变时不会再次弹窗；也可随时删除区域文件重新框选。
column3: the selection window pops up only once for this run to reselect and overwrite the saved regions (not per image). It will not pop again while engine parameters are unchanged; you can also delete the region file to reselect anytime.

key: 文块保留规则（整图过滤模式）
整图过滤模式下，文字块满足何种条件才算“在区域内”。
column3: what condition makes a text block count as "inside the region".

key: 区域内识别到多个文字块时的连接符。默认无。例如识别地址等多段文本时，可填一个空格。
en_US: Separator between multiple text blocks in one region. Empty by default. For multi-line fields such as addresses

key: 用 {区域名} 引用区域识别文本。留空则按「区域名：文本」分行输出。示例：发票号码是《{发票号码}》，税额是《{增值税额}》。
en_US: Use {region-name} to reference the recognized text. Leave empty to output "name: text" lines. Example: invoice no is 《{发票号码}》

key: 把每张图片的区域识别结果写入文件。CSV 为 UTF-8 BOM，Excel 可直接打开。
en_US: Write per-image region results to file. CSV is UTF-8 with BOM so Excel opens it correctly.

key: 导出文件保存目录。默认在插件目录下的「导出结果」文件夹。
en_US: Directory for exported files. Defaults to the "导出结果" folder inside the plugin directory.

key: PaddleOCR-json.exe 的路径。留空时自动在本插件目录或官方 Paddle 插件目录中查找。
en_US: Path to PaddleOCR-json.exe. Leave empty to auto-search in this plugin directory or the official Paddle plugin directory.

key: 使用MKL-DNN数学库提高神经网络的计算速度。能大幅加快OCR识别速度，但也会增加内存占用。
en_US: Use the MKL-DNN math library to speed up neural network computation. Greatly accelerates OCR but increases memory usage.

key: （未找到模型库，请先组装引擎文件）
en_US: (No model library found. Assemble the engine files first.)

key: 启用方向分类，识别倾斜或倒置的文本。可能降低识别速度。
en_US: Enable direction classification to recognize tilted or upside-down text. May reduce speed.

key: 将边长大于该值的图片进行压缩，可以提高识别速度。可能降低识别精度。
en_US: Images with a side longer than this value are compressed to improve speed. May reduce accuracy.

key: 选择一个已保存的预设后，识别时直接使用该预设的区域，不再弹出框选窗口。新增或修改预设后，请重新打开本设置页（或重启 Umi-OCR）刷新列表。
column3: recognition uses that preset's regions directly with no selection window. After adding or changing presets
column4: reopen this settings page (or restart Umi-OCR) to refresh the list.
